title: English: Where do we learn? 🏫
summary:
1. Verbs for He, She, It:
When we talk about He, She, or It, we add -s, -es, or -ies to the action word.
• I go ➔ He goes
• We do ➔ She does
• They play ➔ It plays

2. Short Forms:
We can make words shorter by using an apostrophe ( ' ).
• It is ➔ It's
• Is not ➔ Isn't
• Do not ➔ Don't
• Does not ➔ Doesn't

3. This, That, These, Those:
• This (one thing, close to you)
• That (one thing, far away)
• These (many things, close to you)
• Those (many things, far away)

4. Capital Letters:
Always use a big letter (Uppercase) for the word I, the beginning of a sentence, days of the week, and names of school subjects.

5. Classroom Words:
Things we see at school: Board (teacher writes here), Desk and Chair (where you sit), Pencil, Book, Ruler, and Backpack.

6. School Lessons & Objects:
• Maths: Numbers and calculators.
• English: Reading books and dictionaries.
• Science: Plants and magnifying glasses.
• Art: Drawing and painting.
• Music: Singing and playing piano.
• PE: Running and playing sports.
• Citizenship: Rules and community.
